high_level_description: This image captures a heartwarming moment during what appears to be a traditional Indian wedding ceremony. The central focus is on two individuals who are embracing each other affectionately. Both are adorned with elaborate floral garlands made of white jasmine flowers, red roses, and yellow marigolds, which are symbolic in many Indian weddings. The person on the left is wearing a cream-colored dhoti with green and gold borders, typical attire for men in South Indian weddings. They have a broad smile and appear to be in a joyful mood.
